vectors.name: is_empty/basic/mandatory-self-cycle-is-empty
vectors.comment: A required reference cycle: every document would be infinite, so no finite Document can match it -- the model's canonical unsatisfiable-schema example.

vectors.name: is_empty/basic/optional-self-cycle-is-not-empty
vectors.comment: The same cycle shape as the vector above, but the field is optional (min=0) so the cycle never blocks satisfiability -- optional never blocks, per record_satisfiable.

vectors.name: is_empty/basic/any-is-always-satisfiable
vectors.comment: any is treated as satisfiable since it admits every value.
